detail: Full summary: Execute-vs-preview discrepancy worth a look: preview reported deduplicated.removed=10, execute reported 0 — the intervening auto-archive pass (73 entries) appears to have absorbed the duplicates before dedup ran. Not a bug in the new passes, but pass-ordering makes preview counts non-binding for dedup; could confuse users comparing preview to execute.
